counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的应用，找出哪些代码有测试、哪些没有，并生成一个覆盖矩阵和优先级列表，帮你决定先补哪些测试。
howto.when: 当你提到“测试覆盖”、“哪些没测试”、“覆盖缺口”、“缺失测试”、“覆盖报告”或“需要测试什么”时触发。

say.text: 分析一下我们项目的测试覆盖缺口
say.note: Claude 会扫描应用并生成覆盖矩阵。
Claude 会列出缺失测试的页面。

say.text: 帮我生成缺失测试的优先级列表
say.note: Claude 会按业务影响排序并给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your application to identify which code has tests and which doesn't, then generates a coverage matrix and prioritized list to help you decide which tests to write first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "test coverage", "what's not tested", "coverage gaps", "missing tests", "coverage report", or "what needs testing".

say_en.text: Analyze test coverage gaps in our project.
say_en.note: Claude scans the app and generates a coverage matrix.

say_en.text: Generate a prioritized list of missing tests.
say_en.note: Claude ranks gaps by business impact and suggests a test plan.
